children: Proteomics platform provider's Q3 revenue fell yr/yr
Net loss narrowed to $13.7 mln, with operating expenses down 23% yr/yr
Company cut 2026 revenue guidance, citing extended sales cycles from funding pressures
Seer lowers 2026 revenue guidance to $13.5 mln-$14.5 mln from $16 mln-$18 mln
Company cites extended sales cycles due to pressure on academic and government funding
CUSTOMER ACTIVITY - Co said established customers made repeat consumables purchases and new pharmaceutical customers adopted its platform
FUNDING PRESSURE - Co cited continued pressure on academic and government funding as extending sales cycles and delaying late-stage opportunities
OPERATING COST REDUCTION - Co attributed lower operating expenses primarily to reduced employee compensation, including stock-based compensation
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the office equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Seer, Inc. is $4.00, about 138.1% above its November 9 closing price of $1.68
